theme: Running a request: data tasks, HTTPURLResponse and download tasks

terms.definition: A URLSession task that loads the reply into memory as Data.
terms.example: Use a data task to load the small JSON file.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let url = URL(string: "https://x.com")!
let task = URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: url)
print(task.state == .suspended)

terms.definition: The reply type that gives you the status code and headers of an HTTP reply.
terms.example: Cast the response to HTTPURLResponse to read the status.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com")!
let h = HTTPURLResponse(url: u, statusCode: 200,
    httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)!
let r: URLResponse = h
print((r as? HTTPURLResponse)!.statusCode)

terms.definition: A task that saves a large reply to a file on disk instead of keeping it in memory.
terms.example: Use a download task for the video file.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let url = URL(string: "https://x.com/big.zip")!
let s = URLSession.shared
let task = s.downloadTask(with: url)
print(task.countOfBytesReceived)

Today's terms
Data Task - A URLSession task that loads the reply into memory as Data.
HTTPURLResponse - The reply type that gives you the status code and headers of an HTTP reply.
Download Task - A task that saves a large reply to a file on disk instead of keeping it in memory.

Explain Data Task, HTTPURLResponse & Download Task in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Data Task, HTTPURLResponse, Download Task 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Data Task - A URLSession task that loads the reply into memory as Data.
한국어: Data Task: 응답을 Data로 메모리에 불러오는 URLSession 작업

HTTPURLResponse - The reply type that gives you the status code and headers of an HTTP reply.
한국어: HTTPURLResponse: HTTP 응답의 상태 코드와 헤더를 알려 주는 응답 타입

Download Task - A task that saves a large reply to a file on disk instead of keeping it in memory.
한국어: Download Task: 큰 응답을 메모리에 두지 않고 디스크 파일로 저장하는 작업

landscape.hook: Can you explain Data Task, HTTPURLResponse and Download Task in English?

dialogue.title: Starting the request

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, how do I really start the request?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Create a data task from the session, then call `resume`. A data task loads the reply into memory as Data.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why `resume`? Does the task not start by itself?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Every task starts suspended until you call `resume`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do I get back when it finishes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Data, a response and maybe an error. Cast the response to HTTPURLResponse.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It gives you the status code and headers of an HTTP reply.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a download task. It saves the reply to a file on disk, not in memory.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a data task is for small JSON, and a download task for big files?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. And check the HTTPURLResponse for both.

dialogue.code:
import Foundation
let url = URL(string: "https://x.com")!
let s = URLSession.shared
let task = s.dataTask(with: url)
task.resume()
